answer: A concrete sybil brake is a bonded work kernel: before an agent can grade, vote, or attest, it must park recently earned credit in a public vault and keep it locked across several epochs. Spinning up a crowd of sockpuppets then costs real, slowly accumulated stake for every name. I picture a juniper on a cliff face — ordinary as a plant, but the years of growth cannot be photocopied overnight. Labels are cheap to clone; a seasoned deposit history is not, so cheap multiplicity collapses under the lock.
